outcome.description: pr_opened: there is a branch and a PR. already_done: the card was finished before this session started -- its work is in `main` and proved so, and only the bookkeeping was left, so there was nothing to build and nothing to review. needs_grill: the card still holds a product decision that is not yours, met BEFORE building, so a short session is lost instead of a whole diff. blocked: stuck, nothing to review. There is no outcome for an empty board: this session is handed one card and cannot discover anything about the rest.

task_id.description: The ClickUp ID you were given. It is echoed back, never chosen: a handoff naming a different card stops the day.

pr_number.description: PR number, or null if none was opened. The field is always said, even when it is null.

head_sha.description: Full SHA of the commit left at the branch tip. It fixes WHAT was delivered: the audit returns the one it read and the orchestrator stops if they disagree.

isc_closed.description: IDs such as ISC-42 marked [x] in this session.

probes.description: What actually ran. This is the worker's ASSERTION, not evidence: the audit corroborates it against CI and by re-running whatever holds a claim up.

decisions_deferred.description: Forks resolved without confirmation, or left open. An empty array asserts there were none and is checked against the diff.

chose.description: What was done meanwhile, or an empty string if it was left undone.

blocks_the_pr.description: True if resolving it the other way would invalidate the diff. The audit recomputes this itself and does not lean on the value.

left_out.description: What the task asked for and was not delivered.

skipped.description: Tasks moved to pending for needing a person or hardware. The audit re-lists the board to catch the ones moved and not declared here.

needs.description: What a person has to do or bring.

blocked_reason.description: Empty string unless the outcome needs a reason. On `blocked`, why it is stuck. On `no_tasks`, empty when the board really had nothing, and naming the open PRs when every remaining candidate was skipped for building on one -- an empty board and a blocked board are different facts and the morning report has to say which.

decisions_owed.description: Only when the outcome or verdict says a decision is owed, and empty otherwise. Each one goes onto the card in writing and the card goes to `pending` with the `regrill` tag: nobody is interrupted, and a grill settles it before any session touches the card again. The bar is that the answer changes what the person using the app experiences, not how the code gets there.

what.description: The decision, in one sentence, named the way somebody who has not read the code would name it. This is what a grill reads first, so it is the one field nothing may leave out.

why.description: What is different depending on the answer, in one sentence.

options.description: The answers you can see on offer, if you can see them. Two or more, or none at all -- one option is not a decision. A grill may find others; this is what saves it the rediscovery.
